title: Dataset for "Monkeyflower (Mimulus) uncovers the evolutionary basis of the eukaryote telomere sequence variation"
author: Choi, Jae Young
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Analyze TR sequences and phylogenetic trees
steps.instruction: Dataset used for manuscript "Transposition, duplication, and divergence of the telomerase RNA underlies the evolution of Mimulus telomeres". Final_TR_combined_aligned_CORE_12052023.fas Multi-sequence alignment of the TR sequences that were analyzed in this study. RAxML_bipartitions.newick Phylogenetic tree of the TR multisequence alignment with bootstrap support after 1,000 replicates. RAxML_bestTree.newick The best fitting maximum-likelihood tree for the TR multisequence alignment

substeps.instruction: Use dataset 'Final_TR_combined_aligned_CORE_12052023.fas' for multi-sequence alignment of TR sequences
Refer to 'RAxML_bipartitions.newick' for phylogenetic tree with bootstrap support after 1,000 replicates
Use 'RAxML_bestTree.newick' for the best fitting maximum-likelihood tree for TR multisequence alignment
